0.original: Wuk Lamat wishes to do what she can for the people of Solution Nine.

25.original: Speak with Wuk Lamat in the Backroom.

48.original: Thank you, Otis... I pray your soul is at peace.

49.original: To slaughter his adopted people too... Is there no end to his villainy?

50.original: I did not expect that such carnage would unfold here...

51.original: I've been thinking... By wearing regulators, the people of Alexandria had been spared the fear of death.

52.original: That's because the device not only resurrects you─it also erases your memories of the departed. The very notion of dying would have become vague, if not forgotten.

53.original: To be killed over and over... I can't imagine how traumatized the survivors must be. Even if they're not physically hurt, they would still need care.

54.original: At a time like this, the citizens need their queen to console them. But where has she gone?

55.original: I don't know. There are other districts, so perhaps she's checking on them.

56.original: In any case, it's too much for her to handle alone...

57.original: Countless people will be distraught, and we ought to provide them with what comfort we can.

58.original: So while Cahciua and her crew tend to those with physical injuries, let's seek out those whose wounds are emotional.

59.original: Understood. If you and <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> want to concentrate on True Vue, the rest of us will see to the other areas.

60.original: Sounds like a plan. Alright, everyone─we'll meet up in the Backroom after.

63.original: It makes no sense... What right did the king have to destroy our lives like this?

64.original: Give us back our peace... Leave us out of your damned war... <sob>

65.original: I want no part in it. I just want peace again...

66.original: <shudder> Never have I been so scared in my life... I'd died in an accident before, but it was nothing compared to this...

67.original: To be killed again, and again, and again... It was a living nightmare. And King Zoraal Ja was behind it, you say?

68.original: Since he suddenly appeared, he's done nothing good for us. He thinks only of war─ordered more soldiers be produced. And now he unleashes them on us...

69.original: He's no king of mine! He's a murderer, and someone needs to make him pay!

70.original: Zoraal Ja must answer for his crimes! The false king must be ripped from his throne!

71.original: Th-Thank you... I'm all right, I think...

72.original: Say, you were fighting with Queen Sphene, weren't you? Are the rumors true, then?

73.original: That Her Majesty isn't a living person. That her actual body is elsewhere─in the cloud or some such─and she uses a special power to appear before us.

74.original: I'd always wondered why the Alexandrians never questioned her true nature, but now I think I understand why.

75.original: She personally fought to protect us. That's enough for me to know she's a worthy ruler. It doesn't matter what she is.

76.original: To fight for her people is proof of her dedication to her people. Whatever she may be, she is our queen.

77.original: We've helped those we could in Solution Nine. We're now looking to send people to the other levels.

80.original: It seems things are somewhat under control. While Alisaie and the others are still out there...

81.original: I couldn't help but worry about Gulool Ja.

82.original: He hasn't uttered a word. And small wonder given his ordeal...

83.original: I'm going to talk to him. About everything.

84.original: Bright as he is, there's no use hiding it. He'd eventually find out, and it'd hurt him more.

85.original: Very well. Above all, he needs to know that he isn't alone.

86.original: To make your own child suffer so... I cannot comprehend the heartlessness.

87.original: I'll leave nothing out. Neither what's happened, nor what's still to come...

88.original: They had been keeping a lot inside, both Gulool Ja and Wuk Lamat...

89.original: I'm sorry I didn't listen and followed you.

90.original: But...I wanted to stop my father. And to maybe understand why he did what he did.

91.original: You should get some rest, Gulool Ja. You've been through a lot.

92.original: I do feel a bit sleepy...

93.original: There's a room in the back you can use. Could you take Gulool Ja there?

95.original: The things I would say to Zoraal Ja as a mother... But I'd better not get started.

96.original: Instead, let me thank you. We couldn't have gotten through this without you and yours.

97.original: Until the others return, you ought to take what rest you can as well. It isn't over yet, after all.

98.original: You could head...<buzzz>...prepare for...<buzzz> Otherwise feel free...<buzzz>...the Backroom.

99.original: A fuzzy image, you say? Is it still happening?

100.original: Well, it's an old worn thing. There's bound to be a few hitches.

101.original: It's nothing to worry about, though. We'll have a meeting to discuss our next move in a little while, so until then!
